name: Enhanciar
description: Official remote MCP server for Enhanciar, a company brain. Answers questions from your Slack, Gmail, Drive, Notion, Jira, Linear, GitHub, Zendesk and Postgres with a link to the source, and can propose a reply or ticket for a person to approve. Needs an Enhanciar API key sent as a Bearer token. Paid plans; bring your own AI key.
author: Enhanciar
